Man Fatally Shot by ICE Agent in Houston; Family Seeks Probe

Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a Mexican national, was fatally shot by a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent on Tuesday in Houston, Texas. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) stated that Araujo was not the intended target for arrest, as agents were seeking a different individual during a traffic stop. Witnesses and the family are challenging the agency's account and have called for an independent investigation into the killing. The incident occurred in Magnolia Park, and Araujo was reportedly on his way to work. The family learned of his death through news reports.
